inventory_partial_reserve.code:
from minishop.inventory import Inventory
i=Inventory({'book':2,'pen':0})
try: i.reserve_many({'book':1,'pen':1})
except ValueError: pass
assert i.available('book') == 2

dev_coupon_minimum.code:
from minishop.cart import Cart
from minishop.catalog import Catalog,Product
from minishop.pricing import quote,Coupon
c=Cart(); c.add('book')
assert quote(c,Catalog([Product('book','Book',2000)]),Coupon('X',10,2000)).discount_cents == 200

orders_live_staging.code:
from minishop.cart import Cart
from minishop.catalog import Catalog,Product
from minishop.inventory import Inventory
from minishop.orders import OrderService
c=Cart(); c.add('book'); i=Inventory({'book':3})
OrderService(Catalog([Product('book','Book',2000)]),i).place(c)
assert i.available('book') == 2

inventory_snapshot_alias.code:
from minishop.inventory import Inventory
i=Inventory({'book':2}); s=i.snapshot(); s['book']=0
assert i.available('book') == 2
